name: UpwindImageScan
description: Scan a container image with Upwind ShiftLeft and comment the results on the pull request
helpMarkDown: Scans a container image for vulnerabilities, secrets and malware with Upwind ShiftLeft. Set postComment to post the results as a sticky comment thread on pull request builds; grant the project build service identity 'Contribute to pull requests' on the repository to enable it.
author: Upwind

inputs.name: dockerImage
inputs.label: Docker image
inputs.helpMarkDown: Image to scan, for example myapp:$(Build.SourceVersion).

inputs.name: upwindClientSecret
inputs.label: Upwind client secret
inputs.helpMarkDown: Upwind ShiftLeft credential client secret. Pass a secret pipeline variable, for example $(UPWIND_CLIENT_SECRET).

inputs.name: dockerUser
inputs.label: Registry user
inputs.helpMarkDown: User to authenticate to the image registry, for images pulled from a private registry.

inputs.name: dockerPassword
inputs.label: Registry password
inputs.helpMarkDown: Password or token to authenticate to the image registry. Pass a secret pipeline variable, for example $(REGISTRY_PASSWORD).

inputs.name: dockerPull
inputs.label: Pull image
inputs.helpMarkDown: Pull the image before scanning. Disable when the image was built earlier in this pipeline.

inputs.name: ociClient
inputs.label: OCI client
inputs.helpMarkDown: Client used to pull the image: docker (default), podman or skopeo.

inputs.name: additionalRegistries
inputs.label: Additional registries
inputs.helpMarkDown: Comma-separated list of additional registries to associate with the scanned image.

inputs.name: mainBranch
inputs.label: Main branch
inputs.helpMarkDown: Base branch to diff against. Introduced and resolved CVEs are computed against the latest scanned image of this branch. Defaults to the pull request target branch on pull request builds; set it to override, or to diff non-PR builds.

inputs.name: blockOn
inputs.label: Block on
inputs.helpMarkDown: Fail the task when the image verdict reaches this level.

inputs.name: enforceBlockPolicy
inputs.label: Enforce organization block policy
inputs.helpMarkDown: Fail the task when the organization's Upwind PR block policy blocks the image.

inputs.name: failOnScanError
inputs.label: Fail on scan error
inputs.helpMarkDown: Fail the task when the scan cannot complete. Without it the scanner exits 0 on most scan failures, so a blocking build can pass on an image that was never scanned.

inputs.name: postComment
inputs.label: Post PR comment
inputs.helpMarkDown: Post the scan results as a comment thread on pull request builds. Requires the one-time "Contribute to pull requests" grant for the project build service identity.
